expected_behavior: When the otter-skills MCP tools are not registered, the agent says so and reads the files directly instead of pretending a search ran.
A known identifier is looked up with find_symbols or search_code; a described behaviour starts with search_knowledge and is confirmed with search_code or read_code before it is quoted.
A hit is opened before its text is quoted, because an index row is a whole file and not a line.
A capped search_code result is narrowed and run again rather than read as the complete list.
When the index is unavailable, the agent falls back to the exact tools instead of stopping.
source: Failure modes, and what each means
